program: Science and Management of Biomedical Therapeutics Minor

all_of.source_quote: at least two core courses (selected from the four below) are required
all_of.description: At least two core courses from the four listed RXRS courses.

of_which.source_quote: 16 of which must be at the 300 or 400 level
A maximum of 4 units of lower-division course work is permitted
A maximum of 4 units can be met by taking Directed Research

all_of.source_quote: consists of a minimum of 20 units of Pharmaceutical and Regulatory Science
all_of.description: Minimum 20 units (5 courses) of RXRS/BPSI coursework, with 16 units at 300/400 level, up to 4 units lower-division, up to 4 units of RXRS 490x directed research, and the required core courses may count toward the five-course minimum.
all_of.note: Students may select courses from the required core category to complete the five-course minimum, restated here rather than as a separate node.

requires: minimum 32 USC units as entering freshman or 16 units as entering transfer student

all_of.source_quote: Only students with a declared major are eligible to apply
all_of.description: Admission to the minor requires a declared major and sophomore standing with minimum unit thresholds.
